'''Jorgan Blech''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Bold Dove]]''. Blech once made the mistake of comparing [[Brooser]], an easily agitated [[Human/Legends|Human]], to a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. Once Brooser was finished beating the captain, a Wookiee then beat Blech with its own hands for the insult to his people.
